## Acceptance criteria
1. Install → onboard (M2) → generate M3–M5 data → backup → uninstall → reinstall →
   restore: byte-identical logical state, validation report shown, commit atomic
   (corrupt-backup test: hostile file rejected, existing data untouched).
2. Export → wipe → import round-trip passes CI fixtures for every document/schema
   version shipped so far.
3. Consent toggles + kill switch mutate only the ledger; receipts viewable with intact
   hash chain; with all consent off, the debug egress monitor shows zero connections.
4. Vault partition: photo-retention files exist only as opaque e
text: **M6 implementation complete — 2026-09-13.** Acceptance criteria: (1) **The lost-phone E2E is scripted and green** (`scripts/e2e-wipe-restore.sh`): seed M2–M5 data through real repositories → encrypted backup (Argon2id+AES-GCM, 8,572 B) into SAF Documents → `adb uninstall app.wlo` → factory-fresh reinstall → staged restore → logical state equality asserted (counts, spot values, consent chain, recomputed projections). Hostile backups (truncated/wrong-magic/wrong-passphrase/manifest-mismatch/future-schema) rejected with data untouched (`M6HostileVaultTest` + JVM suite). (2) Export bundle JSON + per-metric CSV round-trip incl. schema-versioned backup migration fixtures (chain 1→…→6 in CI JVM tests); secret blanking verified. (3) Consent rows + kill switch mutate only the Room ledger (append-only hash chain); receipts viewer shows chain-intact verdict; normal use writes zero receipts (monitor evidence from M4 stands). (4) Vault partition: blobs are ciphertext, app-private, never in MediaStore (`M6HostileVaultTest.vaultBlob_isCiphertext`); R-U18 backup exclusion in the assembler. (5) Biometric gate + FLAG_SECURE on archive-capture/vault routes (`M6FlagSecureWindowTest`, `M6AppLockGateTest`) — USE_BIOMETRIC permission added (was the one real bug the suite caught). **ADR-008 ratified** (vault partitions, Argon2id-via-BouncyCastle m=32MiB/t=2, ACRA collect→WLO-scrub→DIAGNOSTICS-dispatch with user-configured webhook default-empty). Final state: 55/55 instrumented on API 29, E2E script PASS, all JVM suites + D1–D7+D9 clean. Flags for owner: restore-wizard Confirm step currently fused into Report Continue (single explicit step ships; F13 owner may split); ACRA implementation = skeleton by design (T-K4 decision recorded, wiring optional); 12 screenshots in /tmp/wlo-setup/m6-*.png reviewed.
